description: Accept a delegation invitation using the `token` from the invite link. Requires being signed in as the invited email address: it grants operator access to your own account. No new token is returned — keep using yours. Requires: token of the invited email.

token.description: Required. Invitation token from the accept link in the invitation email — the long random string after `token=` in the URL, e.g. "9f3c…e1a7".

name: accept_delegation
title: Accept delegated access
